name: Matrixdock Short-Term Treasury Bill Token
oneLiner: STBT is Matrixdock's rebasing Treasury-backed issuer debt, redeemable by eligible investors subject to losses and settlement limits.
collateral: Short-term U.S. Treasury bills and tokenized USTB and BUIDL fund interests held through issuer affiliates; holders have an unsecured Prometheus debt claim.
pegMechanism: Business-day rebasing distributes portfolio returns while targeting $1 per token. Accredited, allowlisted investors redeem into USD-pegged digital assets. The April 2026 operational update states a 0% redemption fee, T+0 for redemption requests up to $1M and T+2 for larger requests. The issuer's daily quick-redemption quota governs T+0 availability. Governing terms retain an unsecured issuer claim, loss and transaction-cost deductions, and account-based redemption restrictions.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Native Ethereum STBT is rebasing unsecured Prometheus debt backed through affiliates by short-duration Treasury assets and Treasury fund interests. The tbill family describes the backing and NAV process without granting holders direct Treasury or fund-share title.

proofOfReserves.provider: Matrixdock issuer dashboard and hash-registered asset statements; the issuer-maintained FallbackReserveFeed replaced Chainlink PoR, and no current independent STBT financial assurance was retrieved

notices.title: Unsecured debt and restricted redemption
notices.message: STBT holders have an unsecured claim against Prometheus, not ownership of Treasury or fund assets. Transfers require allowlisting. April 2026 operational redemption terms do not remove the January 2025 legal loss deductions or account restrictions. BNB Chain and Arbitrum links on the issuer site refer to separate non-rebasing wrapped tokens, excluded from native STBT supply.
